info.title: Plomvix API
info.description: Plomvix — Indian-built, open-source unified observability and general-purpose database. Supports logs, metrics, telemetry, key-value, and JSON data.

tags.name: Ingest
tags.description: Data ingestion — logs, metrics, JSON, KV

tags.name: Query
tags.description: Data queries — time-range scans and point lookups

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: System administration — WAL, cold tier, schema, stats

tags.name: Theme
tags.description: UI theme configuration and design tokens

CookieAuth.name: plomvix_token
CookieAuth.description: httpOnly browser session cookie set by POST /auth/login

get.description: Returns server health information including version, uptime, runtime stats, and WAL/hot/cold tier status.

post.description: Authenticate with username and password to receive a JWT token.

200.description: Authentication successful. Also sets httpOnly cookie plomvix_token for browser clients

get.description: Returns the complete OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification for the Plomvix API as JSON.
Serves the interactive API documentation UI (Swagger UI or Scalar) for browsing and testing the Plomvix API.

post.description: Invalidates the current JWT token, logging the user out of the session.

200.description: Logout successful. Clears the plomvix_token cookie

post.description: Exchange a valid refresh token for a new JWT access token.

200.description: Token refreshed successfully. Refreshes the plomvix_token cookie for browser clients

Returns the active UI theme configuration including color tokens, typography, spacing, shadows, and layout settings.

put.description: Save or update the UI theme configuration. Admin role required.

Retrieve a single user account by its unique identifier. Admin role required.
